principle_violations.reason: The AreaCalculator class has multiple responsibilities: calculating the areas of different shapes and formatting the output. It should focus only on calculations or formatting, not both.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the area calculation logic into its own method or utility class and keep the AreaCalculator responsible solely for managing shapes.

principle_violations.reason: The sum method directly depends on the shape classes, making it necessary to modify this method to handle new shapes. This violates the open/closed principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Use polymorphism by defining a common method for area calculation in each shape class. This removes the need for conditional checks in the sum method.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details above.
